signature: SUBROUTINE DSYGST( ITYPE, UPLO, N, A, LDA, B, LDB, INFO )

params.name: itype
params.reference: -   `= 1`: compute $\operatorname{inv}(U^T) \, A \, \operatorname{inv}(U)$ or $\operatorname{inv}(L) \, A \, \operatorname{inv}(L^T)$; = 2 or 3: compute $U \, A \, U^T$ or $L^T \, A \, L$.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored and B is factored as $U^T \, U$;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored and B is factored as $L \, L^T$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference:
On entry, the symmetric matrix A. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the leading N-by-N upper triangular part of A contains the upper triangular part of the matrix A, and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced. If `UPLO = 'L'`, the leading N-by-N lower triangular part of A contains the lower triangular part of the matrix A, and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced.

On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the transformed matrix, stored in the same format as A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: The triangular factor from the Cholesky factorization of B, as returned by DPOTRF.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
